paite: Huaijiakin I lau ding uh, huchilouin jaw a khawlna a lutna thuchiam om lai napiin, na lak ua kuapeuh leng chinglou bangin na om kha zenzen ding uhi.
english: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

paite: Amau kianga gena hih mahbangin tanchin hoih I kianga gen ahi ngei ngal a; himahleh, a thu jak un amaute a suphatuam ngal keia, azatea ginna toh kizoma a om louh jiakin.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

paite: Ei gingta khinte tuh huai khawlna ah I lut lellel ahi, Ka thangpaiha ka kichiam bangin ka khawlna ah a lut kei ding uh, chih bangin; leilung pian tung akipan nate tuh sep zoh a hikhinta na a.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest”; Psalm 95:11 although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

paite: Koilaimun ahi hiam ah ni sagih ni thu hichibangin agenve: Huan, ni sagih niin Pathianin anasep tengteng a khawlsanta a, chiin.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works”; Genesis 2:2

paite: Huan, hiai munah, Ka khawlna ah a lut kei ding uh, a chi nawn a.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.” Psalm 95:11

paite: Huchiin, khenkhat tuh huai khawlna a a lutna ding ua thuchiam a om lai jiak leh, ni danga tanchin hoih gen tangte thumanlouh jiaka a lut tak louh jiak un,
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter therein, and they to whom the good news was before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

paite: sawttak nungin David ah, Tuniin, chiin, bang ni hiam a sep tuan nawna, Tuniin a aw na jak chiangun na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un, chia a maa kigensa bangin.
english: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.” Psalm 95:7-8

paite: Joshuain amaute na khawlsak ta hileh jaw, huai nungin ni dang tuam thu A gen kei ding hi.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

paite: Huchiin, Pathian mite a dingin khawlni a khawlna a om lai ahi.
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

paite: Pathianin amah nasepte a khawlsan bangin, A khawlna a lut khinsa miin leng anasepte a khawlsan samta ahi.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

paite: Huchiin, kuamah huai thumanlouhna bang a om a ipuk louhna ding un huai khawlna a lut ding in phatuam ingai ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

paite: Pathian thu ahing a, thil ahihthei a, namsau hiamtuah bang chibang sangin leng ahiam a, hinna leh kha, guhlawi leh guhngek tuamkhen hial hel khopin a sun thei a, lungtang a ngaihuah leh tup te a theipah ngal thei ahi.
english: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

paite: Huaziakin, thil siam amah mitmuh a langlou himhim a omkei; Itan chin itutna ding mitmuh a zaw bangkim vuaktangleh kihongsa in a om zaw hi.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

paite: Hichiin, van khawng bang a paisuak khinsa Siampu Lianpen thupitak, Jesu Pathian Tapa, ineih ziakin I gin tuh, I pomkip ding uhi.
english: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.

paite: Siampu Lianpen ihatlouhdan kitheihna te hon theihpih phalou nei ihi ngal kei a; eimah bang a lam tuamtuam a khemna tuaksa, khelh bel khiallou, nei ihi zaw uhi.Huchiin, zahngaihna imuh theihna ding leh huh ideih chiang a huhna hehpihna imuh theihna ding in, hehpihna mangtutphah tuh hangtakin inaih ding uhi.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

paite: Huchiin, zahngaihna imuh theihna ding leh huh ideih chiang a huhna hehpihna imuh theihna ding in, hehpihna mangtutphah tuh hangtakin inaih ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
